No location data in the file, so it is unplaced; which stretch of beach it shows is not confirmed.
photos.n: No GPS in the file: exact stretch of beach not confirmed.

Pintor Dalí: house-side footpath and parking looking south
Pintor Dalí: parking and chain-link fence looking south

Cervantes: straight lane and barred windows
photos.o: Looking along the narrow terracotta pedestrian lane beside a white plaster house. Black iron window grilles, projecting red sills, stepped window surrounds and a traditional wall lantern are clear; clipped hedges and flowering climbers line the opposite side.

photos.t: Cervantes: planting and paving detail
photos.o: Another view along the same straight tiled lane near its Dalí end. Broad-leaved plants, variegated narrow leaves, clipped shrubs and magenta bougainvillea sit in a narrow planting bed above a low white wall. Pale tile joints and flush service covers are visible.

photos.t: Cervantes exit onto Pintor Dalí: slope and drain
photos.o: Looking back toward the asphalt road and the hedge opposite the lane entrance. The tiled approach has white edges, flush utility covers and a transverse drainage grate near the foot. A slight sloping transition is visible; its rise is not measured from this image.

photos.t: Pintor Dalí: parking junction toward the sea
photos.o: Asphalt parking area opening into the narrower seaward aisle. White perpendicular bay markings and parked cars sit beside the houses, with a separate house-side footpath and traditional black lanterns. Fence and tall tree screening line the opposite side, with the sea visible at the far end.

photos.t: Pintor Dalí: aisle, outer fence and white curb
photos.o: A second view of the parking junction and the straight aisle toward the sea. Perpendicular bays meet the junction; the right edge has a low white curb, chain-link screening and mature trees. House-side planting and lanterns help identify the opposite footpath.

photos.t: Pintor Dalí: seaward parking row and chain-link fence
photos.o: Farther down the asphalt aisle, white bay corner markings and parked cars line the house side. The opposite edge shows brown chain-link mesh above a low retaining base, a white-painted curb and dense trees and hedge screening. The boundary continues toward the seaward end.

photos.t: Pintor Dalí: houses, lamps and parking bays
photos.o: Closer view of the house-side parking row toward the sea. A tall black lantern, white plaster frontages, projecting entrance surrounds, clipped shrubs, flowering climbers and a palm sit behind the marked bays. This photo is useful for facade and planting materials.

photos.t: Pintor Dalí: flagstone pedestrian entrance
photos.o: Looking into a pedestrian lane between the houses from the roadside parking. Irregular pale stone paving contrasts with Cervantes’ square terracotta tiles. White curbs separate the entrance from the asphalt and narrow lawns; a tall black lantern, brown shutters, window grilles and flowering climbers frame the route.

photos.t: Pintor Dalí seaward end: turning area and fence
photos.o: The asphalt aisle reaches a wider end area beside the sea. Parked cars remain on the left and clipped screening on the right. A low white wall with dark metal mesh, no-parking signs and a modern flat-headed lamp separates the vehicle area from the paseo/shore beyond.

photos.t: Pintor Dalí seaward end: wall and paseo boundary
photos.o: A closer view of the widened asphalt end area, facing the sea. The low white wall and metal mesh form the frontage boundary; a modern slim lamp and no-parking signs are visible. A pedestrian opening is at the right-hand end; this is not an uninterrupted solid perimeter.

photos.t: Pintor Dalí: raised stone approach and archway
photos.o: A raised flagstone approach leads through an arched passage in the white building. Several shallow steps are visible at the foot between flared white curbs; the passage has patterned paving, lanterns and a gate visible beyond. Dark louvred shutters and a barrel-tile canopy sit above the arch. This is a separate access from the Cervantes ramp and the big-pool steps.

photos.t: Pintor Dalí: pedestrian gate to the paseo
photos.o: Detail of the seaward boundary’s narrow metal pedestrian gate between white walls. Adjacent rigid metal mesh allows a view of the beach and sea; a modern lamp stands beyond. The road edge has a yellow-painted curb, terracotta edging tiles, clipped shrubs and a no-parking sign. The gate provides a specific reference for the pedestrian connection.

photos.t: Beach: resort and restaurant frontage
photos.o: View from the pebble-strewn beach toward the white resort and beach restaurant frontage, with palms and seaward terraces. Useful for broad building silhouettes and the sand/stone mix; no restaurant footprint or beach elevation is measured here.

photos.t: Elena junction: side-by-side ramp and steps
photos.o: Close view of a terracotta approach with a smooth sloping strip beside a flight of shallow steps, low white edging, and a transverse drain at the foot. Clipped hedge, blue flowers and a partially visible Elena plaque identify the junction. The separate steps are visible evidence not yet matched to detailed game geometry.
photos.sub: The steps beside the Cervantes ramp

photos.t: Elena junction: private doorway and planting
photos.o: A private brown timber door sits above small tiled entrance steps behind a low white planting wall. Blue flowers and bougainvillea screen white plaster fronts; a tall black lantern and flush utility cover are visible. Private door steps are distinct from the shared junction ramp.

photos.t: Cervantes area: passage signed Calle Miguel
photos.o: Inside a covered walk-through with a visible CALLE MIGUEL plaque. Red square tiles with small decorative inserts, black hanging lanterns, barred windows, potted plants and an arch opening onto a narrow planted lane are visible. The plaque is observed; association with the full mapped Miguel de Cervantes name needs review.

photos.t: Cervantes exit: white-edged tiled approach
photos.o: Looking toward the roadside hedge over a terracotta approach bounded by low white walls and planting. A drain crosses the lower end and a black lantern stands at the corner. The shape and planting support the entrance reference; the image alone does not measure its rise.

photos.t: Pintor Dalí: grass between bays and shared footpath
photos.o: A parked car and white bay markings sit beside a grass strip with broad-leaved planting. A separate terracotta house-side footpath and white plaster frontages are behind the grass. Confirms the surface order; widths remain estimated.

photos.t: Pintor Dalí: arched entrance and white facade
photos.o: Frontal view of a two-storey white building with an arched ground-level opening, rounded plaster balcony edge, timber shutters, barred window and lantern. The terracotta house-side footpath runs between the facade and a narrow lawn/parking edge.

photos.t: Pintor Dalí: continuous tiled footpath and lawns
photos.o: Oblique view along white two-storey frontages, the shared terracotta path, narrow grass strip and asphalt bays. Arched openings, black window grilles, small balconies and planting divide the frontage. Useful for proportions and surface continuity.

photos.t: Pintor Dalí: lane entrance, ramp and drain
photos.o: A terracotta entrance slopes from the parking area into a narrow lane between white patio walls and dense planting. A green drain/service grate is at the foot and a tall traditional black lantern stands at the corner. Lane name is not visible; do not assume this is Cervantes.

photos.t: Dalí seaward end: flagstone approach to arch
photos.o: Pale irregular flagstone paving leads through an arched covered passage. Flared low white curbs, clipped hedges, blue flowers and climbing plants frame the approach. Stone paving is distinct from the square-tiled entrances elsewhere.

photos.t: Dalí seaward end: covered access and shutters
photos.o: Second view of the flagstone approach and arched passage, showing the tiled canopy, dark louvred shutters, side balcony and planting. Corroborates IMG_2294; it is not independent measurement of the passage dimensions.

photos.t: Dalí seaward end: parking turn and coast boundary
photos.o: View around the widened asphalt end area toward a low white wall and metal fence by the sea. Yellow curb paint, white bay lines, red-and-white post, a no-parking sign, palms and flowering planting identify the coastal turn.

photos.t: Dalí seaward end: narrow pedestrian gate
photos.o: A narrow dark metal pedestrian gate sits beside a white pier, rigid metal mesh on a low white plinth to the left, and a taller solid white wall to the right. A modern slim lamp, yellow curb paint and a no-parking sign identify the asphalt parking end. The wall/mesh/gate arrangement is now represented in the structural model; plan position, gate width and wall heights remain estimates.

photos.t: Beach: white seaward houses and palm
photos.o: Beach-level view back toward two-storey white homes, dark shutters, a palm and the low coast boundary. Sand and scattered pebbles fill the foreground. This camera position is shared with the next two differently directed views.

photos.t: Beach: houses along the shore
photos.o: Oblique beach view along the row of white seaward houses and palms, with a pebbled sandy foreground and distant coastline. Useful for the coastline-side silhouette and texture; individual house positions are not determined from this view.

photos.t: Beach: pebbles, sand and distant coastline
photos.o: Wide view along the beach with mixed sand, stones and rounded pebbles, the sea to the right and low buildings beyond. Provides a stronger ground-material reference than a uniform pale-sand texture.

photos.t: Cervantes at Elena: steps up to a door beside the lane
photos.o: Looking west up Cervantes from the Elena junction. On the right two red-tread steps with white sides climb to a brown timber door between a plumbago hedge and bougainvillea; the lane beyond shows the ramp strip and the steps beside it, a drain across the foot and service covers in the tiles.

photos.t: Cervantes at Elena: ramp and steps side by side, drain at the foot
photos.o: Looking west-south-west up Cervantes: the smooth ramp strip on the left, the white-edged steps on the right, one drain grate right across the lane at the foot, white kerbs and clipped hedges both sides, a door step on the far right. Confirms the split ramp/steps built from IMG_2286.
photos.sub: The ramp and steps side by side

photos.t: Cervantes/Elena junction: lawn with a pollarded tree and white kerb
photos.o: Looking south-south-west across the junction: a small lawn edged by a low rounded white kerb, a pollarded tree with a round head, a manhole cover in the grass, terracotta paving round it, and two-storey houses with bougainvillea and balconies behind.

photos.t: Calle Elena south from the junction, towards the middle pool
photos.o: Looking south along Elena south: a straight square-tiled lane between a hedge and planting on the left and a lawn on the right, white low kerb, pollarded trees, a palm and white terraces at the far end.

photos.t: Middle pool north: crazy-paving path opening onto the lawn and pool
photos.o: Crazy-paving path between a hedge and a white wall, widening into a lawn wedge, with the pool and its glass fence beyond; a black iron gate at the right edge. GPS ±17 m, so the pin is only a rough guide.
photos.n: GPS ±17 m.

photos.t: Middle pool west side: path between the deck and a raised planter wall
photos.o: Looking north-north-west along the middle pool. A grey-brown crazy-paving path with a drain cover runs between the cream pool deck (behind the glass fence) and a raised white planter wall about 0.8 m high topped by a dense hedge with red flowers. Beyond: a lawn inside the glass fence, a white garden wall with a brown arched-top door, a small pergola entrance, clipped hedges and two-storey white houses with bougainvillea. GPS ±14 m, so the pin alone does not fix which lobe.
photos.n: GPS ±14 m. Shows the glass pool fence, which Dave decided to skip.

photos.t: Middle pool south-west: stone steps up a tiled path to a gate
photos.o: A terracotta-tiled path with three rough stone steps climbing between a tall hedge and a raised white wall, to a white gateway with bougainvillea at the top. A change of level leaving the middle pool courtyard.

photos.t: Middle pool south: iron gate in a pergola frame onto a lane
photos.o: Looking south through a black iron double gate under a curved metal pergola frame: crazy paving with a drain grate, a raised white planter with shrubs on the right with a white step, a tiled lane beyond between white walls and planting.
photos.n: User clarification, 21 October 2026: planted frontage strips run along both sides of the tiled lane BEYOND the gate, distinct from the courtyard bench planter and hedge. Photo-left has a low pale kerb with mixed planting, partly occluded by leaf/ladder/cart; photo-right has raised white planter sections under barred openings, interrupted at a recessed doorway. Source-pixel mapping: docs/reviews/middle-pool-south-forecourt/lane-planters/. Exact endpoints and global placement remain unresolved. User also identifies window bars: a projecting black grille with upright bars and horizontal ties is visible over the brown shutter above the right frontage planter, separate from the foreground gate leaf.
photos.sub: south gate, double iron leaves and the planter to its right

photos.t: Middle pool south: raised white planter with a blue tile panel
photos.o: Close view of a raised white rendered planter and wall with a framed panel of blue-and-white tiles, a seat-height wall bench recessed into it with a low plinth in front, and climbers above. Detail for the courtyard walls.
photos.sub: wall bench and blue/yellow tile panel in the west planter, inside the south gate

photos.t: Calle Eva: east gateway into the middle pool courtyard
photos.o: A white gateway with square piers and a gently curved coping over a flat head, an open black iron gate, and a terracotta path with a drain leading through to the middle pool (glass fence, bird-of-paradise, hedges). A Comunidad Villacana notice and two blue dog-rule signs are on the right pier; white walls with planting run either side. Matches the gate seen from inside in IMG_2244.
photos.n: The middle pool east gate from Calle Eva; IMG_2244 shows it from inside.

photos.t: Curved low white wall with hedge, crazy paving and trees
photos.o: A curving low white wall topped by a clipped hedge beside crazy paving, with trees, garden tables and white terraces behind. GPS ±47 m: the place is not established from the pin; probably the middle pool courtyard.
photos.n: GPS ±47 m: location uncertain, probably the middle pool courtyard.

photos.t: Cervantes/Elena junction: lawn corner with pollarded tree and drain
photos.o: The junction lawn from another angle: white rounded kerb, pollarded tree, manhole, terracotta paving with a drain grate in the foreground, bougainvillea on the houses. GPS ±14 m.
photos.n: GPS ±14 m.

photos.t: Pintor Picasso: service road, utility sheds and bins
photos.o: Looking north-west up the asphalt service road off Calle Pintor Picasso. Left: a dark slatted fence, then low white utility sheds with brown doors and a meter box, then a long plain white boundary wall. Right: a low white building on a rough stone plinth with black tubular railings and a short concrete ramp, green and grey recycling bins, and large plane trees. Palms and the mountains beyond.

photos.t: From the paseo: sandstone retaining wall and fence below the south pool
photos.o: Looking north-north-west from the paseo at the yellow sandstone retaining wall with a green mesh fence on top and a clipped hedge behind; the south pool area (pool, glass fence, white terraces) stands above it.
photos.n: Shows the retaining wall right below the south pool.

photos.t: Paseo looking north-east: stamped walk, sandstone retaining wall
photos.o: The seafront promenade: pink-red stamped concrete about 3 m wide with a timber edge onto a strip of sandy, stony beach. On the landward side a yellow sandstone retaining wall about 1.2 m high carries a green mesh fence, with the white seafront houses (round tower with a tiled roof, balconies) standing above it. Slim white lamp posts, palms, the Barraka restaurant and the mountains in the distance. Shows the resort ground standing above the paseo here.
photos.n: The sandstone retaining wall shows the resort ground standing about 1.2 m above the paseo here.

photos.t: Paseo looking south: stamped walk, timber edge, beach and sea
photos.o: Looking south from the paseo over its pink stamped concrete and timber edge to the sandy, stony beach and the sea, a kite-surfer offshore.

photos.t: Paseo looking west: sandstone wall, mesh fence, lamp posts
photos.o: Looking west-south-west along the paseo: the sandstone retaining wall and green mesh fence on the right, slim white lamp posts, palms, beach scrub on the left.

photos.t: Paseo curving north-east beside the sandstone wall
photos.o: The paseo curving north-east with the sandstone retaining wall and green mesh fence on the left, a service cover in the stamped surface, the timber edge on the right.

photos.t: Cervantes/Elena steps from the junction
photos.o: Close view of the three steps beside the ramp: white riser faces, terracotta treads with grey edges, the white wall and hedge on the right, the drain grate across the foot. Confirms the step arrangement built from IMG_2286.
photos.sub: The steps beside the Cervantes ramp

photos.t: Cervantes east of Elena: lane beside a plumbago hedge
photos.o: Looking north-east along Cervantes east of the Elena junction: a square-tiled lane with a low white kerb wall, a tall plumbago and shrub hedge on the left, patches of sun through trees.

photos.t: Roof by Elena: looking down on Elena south and the junction lawns
photos.o: From a roof terrace looking south-south-east: the Elena south lane, small lawns with round clipped shrubs, private patios with walls, a brown door and a lamp post. Overhead layout of the junction's south side.
photos.n: Roof shot: the pin is the roof.
photos.sub: The junction lawns south of Cervantes

photos.t: Roof by Elena: over barrel tiles to the Cervantes patios
photos.o: From the roof looking south-west over a barrel-tile roof: white walls, private patios with bougainvillea and shrubs, a parasol, and the lawns along Cervantes.
photos.n: Roof shot: the pin is the roof.
photos.sub: The walled patios along Cervantes

photos.t: Roof by Elena: looking east-north-east along Cervantes
photos.o: From a roof terrace beside Calle Elena, looking roughly along the line of Cervantes. Below: courtyard walls with magenta bougainvillea, a patio with a timber pergola, arched first-floor windows, a wooden balcony under a small barrel-tile roof and iron balconies. Beyond: flat roofs with solar panels, the long apartment block, a tall palm and the sea at the right. Camera on a roof, so the pin sits inside a registry building.
photos.n: Roof shot. The camera pin is inside a building; the subject is the Cervantes side, up to 50+ m away.
photos.sub: Cervantes east of Elena, seen along its line

photos.t: Roof by Elena: looking down into a gated tiled entry
photos.o: Looking south-west down over barrel roof tiles into a narrow entry between two-storey houses: patterned terracotta floor tiles, a pair of black iron gates in a white gateway topped with bougainvillea, a small first-floor balcony and an arched opening with lantern beyond. Gives the width and enclosure of the entry from above; dimensions are not measured. Camera on the roof of the covered-passage building (registry part 6265201UF1366N_part5).
photos.n: Roof view of the paired private 36/34 gates seen in IMG_2202, with patterned paving and shaped lintel. The pin is the camera on the roof, not the entry. Audit aim is existing estimated gate position, not a calibrated pose.
photos.sub: The gated tiled entry west of the covered walkway

photos.t: Roof by Elena: looking east-south-east over the terraces to the sea
photos.o: Over lichen-mottled barrel roof tiles and a tall magnolia-like hedge: a wooden balcony with a tiled canopy, iron balconies with arched shuttered doors, flat roofs with solar panels and chimneys, a Norfolk pine, palms, and the sea on the horizon. Good for roofscape and facade detail.
photos.sub: The terraces east of Elena north

photos.t: Roof by Elena: looking down the lane to the north pool lawn gate
photos.o: Looking almost straight down from a roof edge, north-north-west: a narrow square-tiled terracotta lane between white walls with a planted strip, private patios behind low walls with brown doors, and an arched white garden gateway with bougainvillea that opens onto crazy paving and the north pool lawn (bollard lights, palm, tree). Shows how the Elena north lane meets the north pool courtyard.
photos.n: Overhead view of where the Elena north lane meets the north pool lawn gate. Audit 2026-10-18: shallow garden arch directly onto crazy paving/lawn, with timber patio door beside it. Different from the covered-building arch and private 36/34 entry in IMG_2202/2361.
photos.sub: The arched gateway at the north end of Elena

photos.t: Roof by Elena: barrel-tile lean-to over a magnolia bed
photos.o: From a roof edge looking south-east: a mono-pitch roof of lichen-mottled barrel tiles drops beside a tall dense magnolia-like shrub. Beyond: a two-storey white front with arched shuttered windows, a small barrel-tile canopy over a balcony and magenta bougainvillea.
photos.sub: The magnolia bed and the lean-to roof beside it

photos.t: Roof by Elena: looking down on the Elena north lane and its planted bed
photos.o: Almost straight down onto Calle Elena north, looking south-south-east: a straight square-tiled terracotta lane about 1.5 m wide with a narrow white edging kerb. On its left a raised planting bed of tall magnolia-like shrubs edged with strap-leaved plants, ending in a small bed boxed by a clipped hedge. On its right white house walls, a white sill/bench and a first-floor balcony with an iron rail. The lane turns right at the far end by bougainvillea.
photos.n: Overhead view of the Elena north lane: width, edging kerb and the planted bed beside it.
photos.sub: The magnolia bed beside the Elena north lane

photos.t: Roof by Elena: patios east of the Elena beds
photos.o: Looking down east-north-east from a roof: private patios behind white walls with bougainvillea, a timber pergola, outdoor furniture, and the tops of the magnolia shrubs. The east-side patios beyond the Elena beds.
photos.n: Roof shot: the pin is the roof.
photos.sub: The private patios east of the Elena beds

photos.t: Roof by Elena: looking south over the Cervantes/Elena junction
photos.o: From the roof looking south: the junction lawns with round shrubs and the Elena south lane, patio walls with bougainvillea and parasols in the foreground.
photos.n: Roof shot: the pin is the roof.
photos.sub: The Cervantes/Elena junction

photos.t: Roof by Elena: patios and terraces south-west, along Cervantes
photos.o: Looking south-west from the roof over walled patios with trees, parasols and bougainvillea to the two-storey terraces along Cervantes and the tall trees on Dalí.
photos.n: Roof shot: the pin is the roof.
photos.sub: The walled patios north of Cervantes

photos.t: Roof by Elena: patios and terraces south-west (second shot)
photos.o: Same view as IMG_2368, slightly to the left.
photos.n: Roof shot: the pin is the roof.
photos.sub: The walled patios north of Cervantes
